..description: Pydantic Python data-validation library, released as its own PyPI package.

pydantic-core.description: Independent Rust/Python validation and serialization package, built and published separately.

tech_debt_tracking.rationale: No enforced TODO/FIXME scanning or debt tracking; occasional issue-linked comments do not constitute automation.

build_cmd_doc.rationale: Root README and AGENTS.md do not give a build command; CONTRIBUTING.md and pydantic-core/README.md do.

deps_pinned.rationale: Both uv.lock files and pydantic-core/Cargo.lock are committed; CI uses frozen sync and locked Cargo builds.

vcs_cli_tools.rationale: GitHub CLI is installed and authenticated; repository API and PR reads succeeded.

automated_pr_review.rationale: Recent PRs showed no automated review authors/comments; coverage status and assignment comments do not generate code reviews.

agentic_development.rationale: No AI coding-agent author/co-author in last 100 commits or agent-run development workflow; a Pydantic usage skill is not active agent development.

fast_ci_feedback.rationale: Recent merged PR checks usually span over 10 minutes; 20 sampled CI durations include many 12–26 minute runs.

build_performance_tracking.rationale: CI caches and PGO optimize builds, but no explicit build-duration monitoring or exported build timing was found.

deployment_frequency.rationale: Tag-triggered PyPI release automation exists, but the latest release history does not show multiple releases each week; no deploy workflow runs found.

single_command_setup.rationale: Fresh-clone development setup is in CONTRIBUTING.md and the core README, not root README, AGENTS.md, or a skill.

feature_flag_infrastructure.rationale: No runtime feature flag platform or custom toggle infrastructure was found.

release_notes_automation.rationale: GitHub release.yml classifies changelog entries; release/prepare.py assembles HISTORY.md and release/push.py opens draft releases.

progressive_rollout.rationale: Not an infrastructure repository; both applications are distributable libraries.

rollback_automation.rationale: Not an infrastructure repository; library versions publish to PyPI rather than run as a managed deployment.

monorepo_tooling.rationale: Root [tool.uv.workspace] lists pydantic-core and CI uses uv --all-packages.

version_drift_detection.rationale: Pydantic pins pydantic-core exactly and tests/test_version.py asserts the runtime core version matches the companion version constant in CI.

release_automation.rationale: Tag-triggered ci.yml builds, attests, and publishes pydantic-core and Pydantic to PyPI.

dead_feature_flag_detection.rationale: Prerequisite feature flag infrastructure is absent.

agents_md.rationale: Root AGENTS.md is over 100 characters but only points to CONTRIBUTING.md; it omits setup, build, test and project conventions.

readme.rationale: Root README.md includes pip installation and a complete validation example.

automated_doc_generation.rationale: mkdocs.yml and mkdocstrings generate API documentation; CI builds and dispatches deployment of docs.

skills.rationale: .agents/skills/pydantic/SKILL.md has valid name/description frontmatter and substantial prompt content.

documentation_freshness.rationale: CONTRIBUTING.md changed 2026-10-26 and README.md changed 2026-10-13, within 180 days.

service_flow_documented.rationale: docs/internals/architecture.md documents model creation, core schema exchange and validation/serialization across packages.

agents_md_validation.rationale: No CI or pre-commit check tests the root AGENTS.md guidance for accuracy.

env_template.rationale: No .env.example or environment-variable setup in root README/AGENTS.md; libraries need no application credentials, but rubric requires a template or documentation.

local_services_setup.rationale: Core library development and unit tests need no external local service; third-party integrations are separate CI tests.

devcontainer_runnable.rationale: The devcontainer CLI is unavailable, and no devcontainer is configured.

runbooks_documented.rationale: No incident-response runbook or dedicated playbook pointer was found; security disclosure policy and release instructions are not incident runbooks.

branch_protection.rationale: Authenticated GitHub API reports admin=false, so branch protection rules cannot be verified under the rubric.

secret_scanning.rationale: No local committed-secret scanner was found; admin access is unavailable to verify native GitHub secret scanning.

codeowners.rationale: No CODEOWNERS file was found in root or .github.

automated_security_review.rationale: No readable automated security assessment found; admin access is unavailable to inspect GitHub code scanning.

dependency_update_automation.rationale: .github/dependabot.yml schedules GitHub Actions and Cargo update PRs; recent Dependabot commits confirm activity.

gitignore_comprehensive.rationale: Root .gitignore covers build, IDE, caches and .DS_Store, but does not exclude .env files.

privacy_compliance.rationale: Both are libraries without direct collection or retention of end-user data.

secrets_management.rationale: Release/docs workflows use GitHub Actions secrets and variables rather than embedding production credentials.

min_release_age.rationale: .github/dependabot.yml sets cooldown.default-days=7 for GitHub Actions and Cargo updates.

issue_templates.rationale: .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE has structured V1/V2 bug and feature request forms.

issue_labeling_system.rationale: Issue labels include bug, feature and topical labels, but no consistent priority tier labels were found.

backlog_health.rationale: 44 of the latest 50 open issues have a title longer than 10 characters and at least one label; none were older than one year.

pr_templates.rationale: The PR template has only a change summary and assignment checkbox; it lacks testing performed and contextual sections.

lint_config.rationale: Both pyproject.toml files configure Ruff; pydantic-core also runs cargo clippy in Makefile/CI.

type_check.rationale: Both packages configure Pyright; core Rust also compiles and runs Clippy in CI.

formatter.rationale: Both packages use Ruff format; core also runs cargo fmt.

pre_commit_hooks.rationale: Root and core have .pre-commit-config.yaml quality hooks; both make install targets install them.

strict_typing.rationale: Pyright strict is limited to root tests/test_pipeline.py; neither package enables strict checking broadly across its Python source.

naming_consistency.rationale: Core Rust compiles with Clippy pedantic and warnings as errors, enforcing naming; root Ruff does not enable naming rules.

cyclomatic_complexity.rationale: Core Ruff C90 and max-complexity=13 enforce complexity; root sets a max-complexity value but does not select C90.

dead_code_detection.rationale: Core Rust Clippy runs with -D warnings, including dead_code; no Vulture/dead-style analysis for root Python modules.

duplicate_code_detection.rationale: No CPD, jscpd, SonarQube or equivalent duplicate-code check for either package.

code_modularization.rationale: The packages have modules and directories, but no import-linter or architectural boundary enforcement was found.

n_plus_one_detection.rationale: Neither validation library owns database queries or an ORM.

heavy_dependency_detection.rationale: Neither package is a bundled web application.

unused_dependencies_detection.rationale: No deptry, pip-extra-reqs, cargo-udeps or CI unused-dependency analysis was found.

unit_tests_exist.rationale: Root tests/test_*.py and pydantic-core/tests/test_*.py contain numerous unit tests.

integration_tests_exist.rationale: Root CI runs third-party and plugin integration tests; core tests exercise its Rust-backed Python API and cross-package integration.

unit_tests_runnable.rationale: Core: python -B -m pytest --collect-only -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_isinstance.py exited zero, collecting 3. Root: identical bounded collection of tests/test_abc.py exited 4 due installed pydantic-core 2.41.5 versus required 2.50.0; no install permitted.

test_performance_tracking.rationale: Root Makefile/CI runs pytest --durations=10 and uploads coverage artifacts; core CI runs tests but has no explicit test-duration report retention.

flaky_test_detection.rationale: Duplicate CI check names occur on a few PRs, but no documented retry/quarantine or tracked flaky-test metrics were found.

test_coverage_thresholds.rationale: Root upload-previews.yml sets SMOKESHOW_GITHUB_COVERAGE_THRESHOLD=91; core Codecov status checks are disabled.

test_naming_conventions.rationale: Both suites conventionally name test_*.py, but neither pytest configuration explicitly enforces a filename pattern.

test_isolation.rationale: Root Makefile and CI support pytest --parallel-threads; core has temporary-workspace and autouse test fixtures and pytest-run-parallel installed.

interactive_qa_exists.rationale: Root README installs Pydantic and validates a User model; core README covers make install and direct SchemaValidator validation, without an auth or service gate.

interactive_qa_runnable.rationale: Dependency installation was barred in this read-only audit; both documented install-and-validate examples give complete fallback interaction paths. Root local collection failure reflects mismatched preinstalled core.

api_schema_docs.rationale: Both are libraries, not hosted service APIs; core schema and generated JSON Schema are not OpenAPI service specifications.

database_schema.rationale: Neither library owns a database schema.

structured_logging.rationale: Neither package depends on a structured logging library nor ships a dedicated logger module.

distributed_tracing.rationale: Logfire docs show optional downstream instrumentation, but neither package configures its own trace/request ID propagation.

metrics_collection.rationale: Logfire integration examples describe metrics for user applications, but there is no package-level telemetry instrumentation.

code_quality_metrics.rationale: Root CI combines and comments on coverage with a threshold; core has Codecov reporting and benchmark dashboards.

error_tracking_contextualized.rationale: Neither package configures Sentry, Bugsnag or Rollbar with contextual production error reporting.

alerting_configured.rationale: No configured alert rule or on-call integration for either library; docs describe optional Logfire alerts for consumer apps.

deployment_observability.rationale: Release CI exists, but package-specific deployment impact dashboards or notifications are not documented.

health_checks.rationale: Neither package is a deployed service needing a health route or readiness probe.

circuit_breakers.rationale: Validation libraries have no application-owned external service dependency requiring a circuit breaker.

profiling_instrumentation.rationale: CodSpeed profiles both packages' benchmarks in CI; core README also documents flamegraph profiling.

dast_scanning.rationale: Neither application is a deployed web service.

pii_handling.rationale: Root docs/errors/troubleshooting.md documents sensitive-value scrubbing for Logfire validation records; core has no package-specific PII-handling guidance.

log_scrubbing.rationale: Root docs explicitly show Logfire ScrubbingOptions for redacting error inputs; core has no equivalent log-scrubbing pattern.

product_analytics_instrumentation.rationale: No Mixpanel, Amplitude, PostHog, Heap or GA4 instrumentation in either library.

error_to_insight_pipeline.rationale: No configured production error tracker that files issues automatically for either package.
